title: lattice.plan_create_input.v5
description: Canonical initial authoring input for a phase-audited plan. Every task requires a design memo. After the complete plan is written, run `lattice plan scope-review` and confirm that every task preserves an owner-supplied work specification without adding a product purpose. あなたがこのToDoに対して、何も考えていないならば、設計メモに `NO_PLAN` と書いてください v5 adds the per-task authored `done_condition`: plain text (or null when the author states none) that Lattice records and shows but never evaluates, never assigns and never records as done. Builds lattice.todo_plan.v8. The author writes intent: ids, titles, phases and edges (see `lattice plan create --template --json`). Every key whose value is constant or null may be omitted and the machine fills it: schema (this version), actor (the seat actor), recorded_at (the current time; an ISO-8601 date-time with an explicit zone is normalised to UTC milliseconds), input_digest (recomputed), tasks[].design_memo (NO_PLAN), tasks[].lane (main), tasks[].narrative_ref, narrative_anchor, compile_binding, parent_task_id and done_condition (null), phases[].gate_policy (heavy), phases[].predecessor_phase_ids ([]), phases[].required_evidence_slots (["acceptance"]), hard_dependencies, joins and phase_accept_dependencies ([]), and project_id/plan_key of an edge reference (this input's own). Every list is sorted into canonical order. A refusal lists every problem at once in detail.problems. Edge direction: from is the prerequisite; to starts after from is done.
$comment: Runtime validation additionally enforces canonical JSON+LF bytes, sorted identifiers and edges, unique ids, combined task/phase acyclicity, byte bounds, non-empty design_memo (omitted, null or blank becomes NO_PLAN), and input_digest (recomputed). v5 additionally accepts hard_dependencies, joins, each joins[].after, phase_accept_dependencies, phases, phases[].predecessor_phase_ids and phases[].required_evidence_slots in any order or with exact duplicates: they are sorted into canonical order and de-duplicated before validation. tasks are sorted by task_id. Entries with the same key but different content are still refused.

recorded_at.description: Any ISO-8601 date-time with an explicit zone (Z or ±hh:mm) whose written fields are a real date and time; the machine normalises it to UTC milliseconds (Z). Omitted: the current time.

tasks.description: task_idの昇順・重複なしで並べる。整列はJSON Schemaでは表現できないがCLIは拒否する。

phases.description: phase_idの昇順・重複なしを正準形とする。入力順は問わず、機械が整列し完全一致の重複を除く。同じphase_idで内容が違う場合は拒否する。全taskのphase_idはここに存在しなければならない。

hard_dependencies.description: Omitted: []. 入力順は問わず、機械が正準順（from、toを(project_id, plan_key, task_id)の辞書順）へ整列し完全一致の重複を除く。 辺の向き: from=前提、to=fromが終わってから始まる。同じplanの辺ならfrom/toはtask_idだけでよい。

joins.description: Omitted: []. 入力順は問わず、機械がidの昇順へ整列する。同じidで内容が違うjoinは拒否する。各afterも同様に整列し重複を除く。

phase_accept_dependencies.description: Omitted: []. 入力順は問わず、機械が正準順へ整列し完全一致の重複を除く。

design_memo.description: Markdown design memo. あなたがこのToDoに対して、何も考えていないならば、設計メモに `NO_PLAN` と書いてください

done_condition.description: Omitted: null. 作成者が書くこのtask固有の終了条件（プレーンテキスト、設計メモと同じ本文規則）。nullは「書かない」。Latticeは記録して表示するだけで、評価せず、作業を割り当てず、doneも記録しない。

gate_policy.description: Omitted: heavy. Phase gateの呼び名。製品はこの値で分岐しないので統制語彙は無く、identifierなら何でもよい。表示に使う。慣用は 'heavy'（重監査）と 'terminal-audit'（暗黙の終端Phaseが使う）。

predecessor_phase_ids.description: Omitted: []. 先行Phase。入力順は問わず、機械がidentifierの昇順へ整列し重複を除く。

required_evidence_slots.description: Phase gateが要求する証跡slot。省略・空なら["acceptance"]。入力順は問わず、機械が昇順へ整列し重複を除く。

nodeRef.description: Reference to a task. Omitted project_id/plan_key: this input's own.

phaseRef.description: Reference to a phase. Omitted project_id/plan_key: this input's own.

to.description: The task that starts after from is done.

edge.description: Hard dependency: from is the prerequisite; to starts after from is done.

after.description: 参照の順序は問わず、機械が(project_id, plan_key, task_id)の辞書順へ整列し完全一致の重複を除く。

authoringDigest.description: canonical入力から算出される自己digest。CLIが読み込み時に必ず再計算して埋めるので、authorは空文字 "" を置けばよい。手で計算する必要はない。
